celda <- function(ct, t, d = 3) if (t %in% rownames(ct))
c(paste0(f2(ct[t, 1], d), estrellas(ct[t, 4])), paste0("(", f2(ct[t, 2], d), ")")) else c("", "")
terms <- c(n65 = "Adultos de 65+ (número)", sinocup = "Hogar sin ocupados", sh_subs = "Proporción en el subsidiado",
ll0  <- function(m) { y <- m$y; p <- mean(y); sum(y * log(p) + (1 - y) * log(1 - p)) }
cuerpo <- map_dfr(names(terms), \(t) { v <- map(cts, \(ct) celda(ct, t)); tibble(` ` = c(terms[t], ""), m1 = v[[1]], m2 = v[[2]]) })
